traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md are implemented and verified:
- **Core Functionality**: The plugin is implemented in TypeScript (src/index.ts) as a standard ESLint plugin module exporting `rules`, `configs`, and a default plugin object. Tests in tests/plugin-setup.test.ts and tests/integration/cli-integration.test.ts confirm it loads, registers rules, and operates correctly via the ESLint CLI. - **Quality Standards**: The project follows ESLint plugin conventions: separate `rules/` directory, `traceability/` rule IDs, flat-config presets (`configs.recommended`/`configs.strict`), TypeScript tooling, Jest test setup, and a built entrypoint at lib/src/index.js referenced by package.json. - **Integration (ESLint v9 flat config)**: ESLint v9 flat config usage is demonstrated and exercised. eslint.config.js uses the plugin in flat config form, and tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts uses `FlatESLint` to verify that `configs.recommended` and `configs.strict` enable the plugin rules as expected. - **User Experience**: README.md and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md provide clear installation instructions, flat-config examples, and guidance for integrating the plugin in real projects, satisfying the setup/documentation aspects of the story. - **Error Handling**: src/index.ts dynamically loads each rule and, on failure, logs a clear error and installs a placeholder rule that reports a diagnostic at runtime. Tests/plugin-setup-error.test.ts and tests/cli-error-handling.test.ts validate this behavior (and CLI-level failure behavior) and passed in the test run. - **Documentation**: Plugin setup, usage, and development/test commands are documented in README.md and the ESLint 9 setup guide.
The automated Jest run (npm test -- --runInBand --verbose) shows all story-linked tests passing, including those directly tied to REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE and REQ-ERROR-HANDLING. Taken together, this provides concrete evidence that the story 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP is fully implemented and behaves as specified.
